ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Use of CSharp Interactive Console
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of CSharp interactive console by PowerShell

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\csi\\\.exe$") AND (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\_ise\\\.exe$")) AND process_original_file_name = "csi\.exe")
